scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && PORT=${PORT:-20541} BASE_PATH=${BASE_PATH:-/} pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.cloudflare:build: test -n "$VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY" || { echo 'Set VITE_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY before building the Cloudflare app.' >&2; exit 1; }; PORT=20541 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/gathering-fallen-live run build
scripts.cloudflare:dev: pnpm run cloudflare:build && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.144.0 dev --config artifacts/api-server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cloudflare:deploy: pnpm run cloudflare:build && pnpm dlx wrangler@4.144.0 deploy --config artifacts/api-server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
